text:
jordan: Quick sync  demo-day fleet + marketplace listing for H200 / Gaudi / MI300 is locked for next Tue. Need final owners for SKU tags, staged image URIs, and partner-only publish window.
anya: I can own the marketplace publish timing. Will need SKU tag list from infra by EOD Fri.
matt: Infra can cut the images and push to staging, but we need the exact `kernel_variant` + quant names. Can someone paste the final SKU strings we want exposed?
bob_nvidia: From Nvidia: we'll surface `h200-std` and `h200-lowlat`. Driver bundle name to follow by tomorrow AM.
sara_amd: AMD will provide `mi300-rtx` and `mi300-thruput`. Well include the firmware note. Need the manifest schema for the marketplace.
raj_si: For the SI installers, please use stable tags, not `latest`. Prefer `redwood/demo-YYYYMMDD` style, e.g., `redwood/gaudi-demo-20260331`.
jordan: Agreed. Proposed canonical tag format: `redwood/<model>-demo-YYYYMMDD` and a companion `redwood/compatible-demo-YYYYMMDD` for fallbacks. Ok?
anya: Works. Marketing needs product blurbs and a preview link by Mon. @leila are you good?
leila: Yes, I can make preview visuals with mock SKUs but need 1-2 line blurbs per vendor. @bob_nvidia @sara_amd please confirm.
bob_nvidia: Draft blurb: "H200: optimized for low p99 latency on short-chat flows; tuned for Redwood batching."
sara_amd: Draft blurb: "MI300: throughput-first, mixed-precision optimized for long-context batching."
matt: Infra plan: images uploaded to `s3://redwood-staging/demos/` with tags like Raj recommended. I'll open a PR with a sample manifest that contains: `model`, `kernel_variant`, `quant`, `driver_version`, `marketplace_sku`.
raj_si: Please include `marketplace_sku` so our installer can auto-select the right kernel/quant combo. Also add `recommended_batch_size` if available.
deploy-bot: build 4899 succeeded for redwood/gaudi-demo-20260331 (sha: d4e5f6) :white_check_mark:
jordan: Two decisions needed today: 1) publish window for partner-only listing? 2) fallback behavior if MI300 driver delayed?
anya: Publish as partner-private Tues 09:00 PT. If MI300 driver slips, we publish the compatible image `redwood/compatible-demo-20260331` and mark perf as "degraded compared to vendor target" in release notes.
bob_nvidia: We'll try to hit the driver timeline but accept the fallback. We'll post any driver changes here immediately.
sara_amd: Same from AMD. If we slip, we'll provide an updated driver manifest ASAP.
leila: I'll prep two announcement templates (partner-only and public) and the collateral preview by Mon EOD.
jordan: Matt, once your PR is up, Raj will validate installers. Please include sample installer mapping in the PR.
matt: PR will be opened in ~90min.
raj_si: I'll test the installer against the manifest once PR lands. If I hit blockers I'll call them out in the PR review.
jordan: Thanks all. I'll post a short checklist tomorrow: image tags, manifest example, blurbs, publish window, fallback image. Please react to claim your action items. :thumbsup:
